scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names free,plus --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=meldrift-free -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000" "npm run dev --workspace=kyuboard -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3001"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=meldrift-free && npm run build --workspace=kyuboard
scripts.typecheck: npm exec --workspace=meldrift-free -- tsc --noEmit && npm exec --workspace=kyuboard -- tsc --noEmit
